definitions: The act of allowing oneself to enjoy a particular pleasure, especially one considered an extravagance.
The state of being indulgent or of having one's desires satisfied.
A thing that is indulged in; a luxury.
In the Roman Catholic Church, a remission before God of the temporal punishment due to sins whose guilt has already been forgiven.
examples: He treated himself to a moment of indulgence.
The Pope granted a special indulgence.
She allowed herself the indulgence of a long bath.
